name: Kiss Me, My CEO Husband
overview: Married into a wealthy family as a stand-in bride? Xia Zhi refuses to follow the script and decides to tear it apart herself. To rebel against her father, she runs away from the wedding. She then mistakenly flirts with a mysterious male model and ends up signing a contract marriage with him. She fights her workplace battles and takes revenge on the front lines, while he quietly protects his “wife” from behind the scenes. When the poor male model’s disguise finally falls away, it’s revealed that he is actually Qi Zhengting, the powerful head of a vast business empire. From pawn to player, Xia Zhi ultimately reclaims everything. And with a wedding watched by the entire world, President Qi declares that she has always been his only preference and salvation.
